method.model_unit: unique call_id; provider.language_generation is a completion record including unsuccessful completed requests
method.source_files: Only exact job directories and *-model.output.json are read for response classification; no model inputs or app bundles scanned.
method.time: Language elapsed sums overlap under concurrency. Interval unions use matching model.started and provider.language_generation timestamps. Job states integrate consecutive job.updated events.
method.usage: Cached input is included in input, reasoning is included in output. No price inferred. A started request without completion has unknown usage.

video_tasks.note: Submitted-to-finished includes polling and local collection; unfinished extra candidate excluded, not treated as zero time.

model_output_classification.note: Plain JSON only; unparsed output retained as not_plain_json rather than guessed.

uninterrupted_job_segment.meaning: Discovery memory is deliberately cleared at every listed job-state event, excluding repetitions across repair/restart/pause/review boundaries. This is stricter than whole-WorkOrder counting. Schema content hashes were not read from large input payloads.

schema_discovery.interpretation: All-previously-discovered responses repeat Tool IDs within a WorkOrder; some schemas may have changed during case repair/repackaging. Do not claim all 802 or all same-ID repeats are guaranteed removable. Retained schema must refresh on actual schema changes. Actual savings need protocol replay and cannot equal summed request elapsed under concurrency.
